title: hesperantha oligantha
intro: Hesperantha oligantha, commonly known as the blue or white corn lily, is a flowering plant species within the Iridaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating coughs, fever, and respiratory issues. Studies have shown that the therapeutic actions of Hesperantha oligantha include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of the plant, such as flavonoids and terpenoids, have been identified, although further research is needed to fully understand their effects.
